blind.description: A freestanding modular section of a stone wall constructed from blocks of varying shades of tan and sandy yellow. The wall features a central vertical pilaster strip on one side and is topped with a smooth, slightly rounded coping or capstone ledge. Surfaces are fully solid and continuous with no gaps, floating pieces, or melted artifacts.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular strip of tan stone with subtly rounded edges along the top ridge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 8 feet tall (about 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5.5 feet wide across its face, with a thickness of roughly 1.5 feet.
